guide.description: The pipe operator | sends one command's stdout straight into the next command's stdin, with nothing written to a file in between. This is how small single-purpose tools like grep, sort, and wc combine into a pipeline that does something none of them could do alone.

exercises.title: Pipe grep into wc
exercises.task: Count how many lines contain '200' by piping grep into wc -l.

access.log.content:
200 GET /home
404 GET /missing
200 GET /about
500 GET /api/users
200 GET /home
404 GET /old-page

hints: grep produces lines, wc -l counts them

criteria.label: Count the 200 lines via a pipe

exercises.title: Count a whole file
exercises.task: Count every line in access.log by piping cat into wc -l.
